retained_probe_history.reason: The homepage (https://lokschuppen-berlin.com/) served <!-- Designed with Readymag --> markup: a client-rendered visual-canvas microsite (generator meta 'Readymag', <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">, page title 'LOKSHUPPEN NEW WEB'). The raw HTML body is only a mount point (<div id="root">) plus a single <script type="module" src="...viewer.js">; there is no server-rendered text content, no application/ld+json, no wp-json, no ICS link, no Fourvenues script, no Sanity config. The linked /contact path 301-redirects back to the same homepage shell, confirming no distinct server-rendered content pages exist on this domain at all.

Decoded the homepage's own inline data-content JSON blob (Readymag's project bootstrap config, embedded server-side in the initial HTML so no JS execution was needed to read it). It contains only visual-canvas metadata for the Readymag page-builder product itself (project id, CDN asset paths, text/style definitions, font/colour settings) -- a design/branding microsite tool, not an events-calendar platform or CMS. No API endpoint, feed URL, or event-shaped data of any kind is referenced anywhere in the retained bootstrap JSON. Readymag is a visual publishing tool (magazine/portfolio-style canvases); there is no known or discoverable public content API pattern for it that would expose structured event records, so guessing one would not be a genuine, evidenced probe.

retained_probe_history.reason: The homepage (https://www.sisyphos-berlin.net/) is titled 'Offizielle Website vom Sisyphos Club Berlin – Shopyphos' and carries two <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks, but both are generic Organization/WebSite schema.org markup (no Event or MusicEvent type, no dates) auto-emitted by the Shopify theme. The site's own internal nav links only to a merch/checkout flow (/cart, /pages/tickets) with no 'Programm'/'Termine'/'Kalender' page. The linked TICKETS page (/pages/tickets) is itself a Shopify product listing (2 dated door-ticket products among an otherwise general merch catalogue), not a calendar. No ICS link, no wp-json, no Fourvenues script, no Sanity/window.__NUXT__ config were present. This confirms the platform (Shopify ecommerce) but not yet whether any structured event feed exists on it.

Having identified Shopify as the platform at Level 1, queried Shopify's own publicly-documented REST endpoints directly: /products.json (returns the full public product catalogue) and, once /collections/tickets.json confirmed a 'TICKETS' collection (products_count: 7), /collections/tickets/products.json. The public products.json endpoint IS a genuine, stable, public JSON API — but it returns only 2 actual ticketed items ('generationS 03. SEPT 2026', 'generationS 10. OKT 2026'), a distinct, occasional day-party sub-series, each with its date only as an unstructured substring inside a free-text product title (no dedicated date/time/venue field on the Shopify product schema at all). This is not a representative feed of Sisyphos's actual regular programme (the club is known to run continuously Fri-Mon with door-only admission and no venue-published lineup calendar); it is a narrow ecommerce ticket listing. No further public JSON path on this domain exposes anything closer to a genuine events calendar.
